description: This source file implements the PayPalRestPayment class, which provides integration with PayPal's REST API for processing payments within the system. It includes methods for validating configuration, initiating transactions, authorizing payments, and handling refunds, though many methods are stubbed or incomplete. The class utilizes Spring's dependency injection and interacts with other system modules and models.
